Problem: What is the remainder of the division (3203 * 4507 * 9929) / 75?

<reflection>
$3203 \equiv 2 \mod 3$, $4507 \equiv 1 \mod 3$, $9929 \equiv 2 \mod 3$ $(3203 \times 4507 \times 9929) \equiv 1 \mod 3$ $3203 \equiv 3 \mod 25$, $4507 \equiv 7 \mod 25$
The division is incorrect: $25 \times 397 = 9925$, so $9929$ leaves remainder $4$, not $24$.
Recompute $9929 \mod 25$ correctly, then recompute the product modulo 25 and combine it with the known modulo 3 result.
</reflection>
